name: Agent
description: AI Agent backend — LLM providers (Azure AI Foundry, Gemini), generic MMGIS tool registry, and REST routes exposed at /api/agent.

descriptionFull.title: Provides a pluggable AI agent backend for MMGIS. Supports Azure AI Foundry and Google Gemini as LLM providers. POST /api/agent plans actions and POST /api/agent/continue accepts bounded client tool results for final or multi-step replies. Per-request runtime capability descriptors extend the static tool registry without executing client code on the server. Includes map, layer, temporal, analytics, and plugin action support.

example.LLM_PROVIDER: (string) Optional 'azure' or 'gemini'; when unset the backend selects an available configured provider
example.PROJECT_ENDPOINT: (string) Azure AI Foundry project endpoint URL
example.AGENT_NAME: (string) Published Azure AI Foundry agent name
example.AGENT_VERSION: (string) Published Azure AI Foundry agent version

envs.WITH_AGENT: (string) Set to 'true' to enable the Agent plugin; any other value disables it

envs.PROJECT_ENDPOINT: (string) Azure AI Foundry project endpoint URL
envs.AGENT_NAME: (string) Published Azure AI Foundry agent name
envs.AGENT_VERSION: (string) Published Azure AI Foundry agent version
envs.MMGIS_PYTHON: (string) Path to Python executable for raster analysis [default 'python3']
